rules.label: Registration completion recorded
rules.rationale: Matches a recorded registration completion event.

rules.label: Registration override recorded
rules.rationale: Registration override is recorded when the commit wait is bypassed.

rules.label: Commit failure recorded
rules.rationale: Commit transaction reaching failed stage is recorded.

rules.label: Commit send recorded
rules.rationale: Matches a recorded commit send event.

rules.label: Profile submission recorded
rules.rationale: Recorded profile event when moving forward from the profile step.

rules.label: Info submission recorded
rules.rationale: Recorded info event when moving forward from the info step.

rules.label: No rule matched
rules.rationale: Fallback when no recorded event from the vocabulary matches.

revision_notes: Editorial correction to the LLM draft: registration completion precedes commit-send under first-match ordering.
Commit send is labelled as a send, not as a transaction outcome.
